scenes.visual_description: Max stands against a plain pale blue background, holding a comically large dentist appointment card at chest height.
scenes.character_action: Max holds the card still and stares at it.
scenes.camera: Locked static medium shot, no camera movement.
scenes.subtitle: The dentist. Today.

scenes.visual_description: Max on the same plain background, an oversized cartoon bullet held between his teeth like a dog with a stick.
scenes.character_action: Max keeps the bullet in his teeth and stays completely still.
scenes.camera: Locked static medium shot, no camera movement.
scenes.dialogue: Max: "So I am biting the bullet."
scenes.subtitle: So I am biting the bullet.

scenes.visual_description: Max alone against a plain light grey background, the bullet gone, shoulders squared.
scenes.character_action: Max closes his eyes for a moment, sets his jaw, then gives one small nod.
scenes.camera: Locked static medium shot, no camera movement.
scenes.subtitle: ...not literally. Obviously.

scenes.visual_description: Max on a plain light grey background, calm, arms relaxed at his sides.
scenes.character_action: Max stands still and looks at the camera.
scenes.camera: Locked static medium shot, no camera movement.
scenes.dialogue: Max: "Bite the bullet means do the hard thing anyway."
scenes.subtitle: Bite the bullet = do the hard thing anyway.

scenes.visual_description: Max on the same plain background, a small steady expression.
scenes.camera: Locked static medium shot, no camera movement.
scenes.dialogue: Max: "She bit the bullet and told her boss the truth."
scenes.subtitle: She bit the bullet and told her boss the truth.
